def rotate_matrix(matrix):
    n = len(matrix)
    for i in range(n // 2):
        for j in range(i, n - i - 1):
            temp = matrix[i][j]
            # Moving element to 0th column
            matrix[i][j] = matrix[n - 1 - j][i]
            # Moving element to (n-1)th row
            matrix[n - 1 - j][i] = matrix[n - 1 - i][n - 1 - j]
            # Moving element to (n-1)th column
            matrix[n - 1 - i][n - 1 - j] = matrix[j][n - 1 - i]

    shift_count = 0

    while permutation:
        min_element = permutation[0]
        min_index = 0

            if permutation[i] <= min_element:
                min_element = permutation[i]
                min_index = i

        permutation = permutation[1:] + permutation[:min_index]

        left_depth = shift_count // (n - 1)
        right_depth = shift_count % (n - 1)
